facts.fact: The Reserve Bank of Malawi said it is developing regulatory measures on fraud, high mobile money charges, failed transactions and utility bill payment, some due soon, per its Director of National Payment Systems Angella Mjojo.
The Reserve Bank of Malawi said it is working on regulatory interventions on mobile money fraud, charges and failed transactions, some expected soon, to strengthen consumer protection.

The Reserve Bank of Malawi said it has received several consumer complaints over mobile money transactions, handled through its consumer protection department, after customers first approach their providers.

MWI.note: No cross-border payment channel is stated.
A digital transformation agenda is mentioned in passing; no strategy is described.
No government online service is stated.
No government payment to people is stated.
No survey share of adults with an account is given.

facts.fact: Mobile money is in use in Malawi, with Airtel Money operating, consumers complaining over mobile money transactions and the Reserve Bank of Malawi working on fraud and charges, per the conference report.

MWI.note: Only difficulties paying utility bills are mentioned; no tax or fee payment is stated.
